readerContract.humanQuestion: I have found a useful way to use AI at work. How do I share it without merely becoming the person everyone asks to do it for them?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Turn one working AI task into a small reusable method another woman can adapt, check and improve with you.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No AI expertise is assumed; the reader may already use a chat tool for ordinary work.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: A finished AI answer is a one-off; a visible method gives another person the inputs, judgment and checks needed to adapt it.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A colleague needs to turn different meeting notes into a clear follow-up without copying someone else’s exact message.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A private 250–350-word NewsStand Patron Saint teaching feature, with the admitted card and existing in-page song control.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I can bring someone with me by sharing the method, while keeping my own judgment in the work.

canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: The admitted profile, its claim record, or its editorial receipt changes.
The NewsStand editorial promise changes or the actual community destination becomes ready.

canonicalTruth.owner: LIBRAiRY Working with AI 101; NewsStand adapts the durable collaboration and retained-human-judgment lesson
canonicalTruth.freshnessTrigger: The linked LIBRAiRY source materially changes or an AI-product-specific claim is introduced.

patternsNotToCopy: its length, episode structure, three-tool comparison, quiz or any current product claim
its legal topic, caller-ID analogy, source claims or news scaffold

glossaryAccumulation.producerGuard: Teach one distinction—answer versus method—without defining a vocabulary list.
glossaryAccumulation.preventionEvidence: The planned article follows one colleague handover from one answer to an adaptable method.

templateRepetition.producerGuard: Use continuous feature prose with one worked case, not repeated tips or status boxes.
templateRepetition.preventionEvidence: The three reader fields move from problem to mechanism to one action.

decorativeAnalogy.producerGuard: Sister Mary Clarence appears only as the explicitly labelled LAiDIES teaching device that frames lifting the room; the method carries the explanation.
decorativeAnalogy.preventionEvidence: The planned mechanism names the task, inputs, instruction, check and human judgment without relying on film knowledge.

referenceConfetti.producerGuard: Use only Sister Mary Clarence; no quotation, lyrics or other references.
referenceConfetti.preventionEvidence: The draft plan names no other cultural reference.

missingMechanism.producerGuard: Show why another person cannot adapt a final answer alone, then name the reusable method components.
missingMechanism.preventionEvidence: The causal sequence separates the result, its inputs/instruction/check, and the colleague’s revision.

genericAction.producerGuard: End with a four-part method note, one low-stakes trial and a request for a specific improvement.
genericAction.preventionEvidence: The useful action tells the reader whom to ask, what to share and what feedback to request.

jargonBeforeMeaning.producerGuard: Use ordinary work language; do not introduce technical AI terms.
jargonBeforeMeaning.preventionEvidence: The article begins with a familiar colleague handover.

disconnectedSystem.producerGuard: Keep the person, the task, AI draft and human check in one visible sequence.
disconnectedSystem.preventionEvidence: The worked case maps each step to a colleague’s distinct adaptation.

joylessInstruction.producerGuard: Use warm, adult prose and a realistic meeting-follow-up example instead of a checklist.
joylessInstruction.preventionEvidence: The lesson gives a concrete social payoff: another woman can improve the method rather than depend on the expert.

purposeTooNarrow.producerGuard: Make one transferable sharing move, not a universal productivity doctrine.
purposeTooNarrow.preventionEvidence: The conclusion applies the method note to one low-stakes task only.

mechanismBeforeMotivation.producerGuard: Open with the burden of becoming the unofficial AI help desk before explaining the method.
mechanismBeforeMotivation.preventionEvidence: The reader’s actual question leads the article.

workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.producerGuard: Keep the meeting-follow-up example short and return to the reader’s own task.
workedExampleOvertakesBookPurpose.preventionEvidence: The transfer action is a separate task selected by the reader.

technicalExplainerVoice.producerGuard: Use task, notes, instruction, check and judgment; avoid agent, prompt-engineering or workflow-system language.
technicalExplainerVoice.preventionEvidence: The planned explanation requires no product-specific or engineering terminology.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: Share the method that produced a useful AI answer—what the task was, what information went in, what you asked for, what you checked and what you changed—so another woman can adapt it rather than depend on you.
causalSequence: A final AI answer fits one situation.
A colleague with a different situation needs the reasoned steps behind it.
Naming task, input, instruction, check and human judgment makes those steps visible.
She can adapt them, show where they fail and improve the shared method.
The group gains a reusable practice rather than one person’s private trick.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A colleague turns meeting notes into a client follow-up and shares the purpose, sanitized notes, request, factual check and edit rather than only forwarding her final message.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A second colleague applies the same method note to turn a project update into a manager briefing, then names one missing check for the shared version.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Choose one low-stakes task this week; send one colleague a four-part method note and ask her to try it on her own version, identify one confusing step and suggest one improvement.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Short headline and deck; linked 250–350-word private article body; exact LUMINAiRY card in relatedPeople; existing KSVL button using the admitted track ID. No community destination.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: One continuous explanation follows one work handover and returns to a distinct transfer; it does not use the standing service-column structure.

analogyPlan.concept: A method lets more than one person make useful work
analogyPlan.analogy: Sister Mary Clarence’s LAiDIES teaching-device frame: strengthen the whole room rather than perform expertise at it
analogyPlan.mapping: The feature moves from one person’s private answer to a shared, revisable method.
analogyPlan.limit: This is LAiDIES’ editorial interpretation of a fictional teaching device, not a quotation, biography, endorsement or claim about the film’s instruction.
analogyPlan.whyItHelps: It gives the collaboration outcome a memorable frame after the plain mechanism is established.

humourPlan.lessonJob: No joke is necessary; warmth comes from the concrete colleague exchange.

communicationDesign.surfaceAdaptation: Use the benchmark as a plain-explanation lens for a short NewsStand teaching feature; adapt the mechanics, never the voice or persona.

humanQuestion.reason: The reader needs to share a useful AI practice without becoming the permanent intermediary.

usefulCuriosity.reason: A polished final answer looks shareable but does not tell a colleague how to adapt it.
usefulCuriosity.plannedEvidence: Contrast forwarding a final answer with sharing its method.

invisibleProcessConcrete.reason: The useful work lies in the otherwise hidden choices behind the answer.
invisibleProcessConcrete.plannedEvidence: Make task, notes, instruction, check and judgment concrete in the meeting-follow-up case.

familiarTechnicalMovement.reason: A familiar colleague handover explains the AI collaboration practice without technical vocabulary.
familiarTechnicalMovement.plannedEvidence: Move from a client follow-up to a reusable method note, then return to a second work task.

limitationsConsequences.reason: The method helps adaptation but does not transfer judgment or justify sharing sensitive details.
limitationsConsequences.plannedEvidence: State that the colleague adapts, checks and improves it using a low-stakes, sanitized example.

humourSurprise.reason: The short feature needs no joke beyond its warm Sister Mary Clarence frame.

betterNextQuestion.reason: The reader should leave able to ask what another person needs in order to use and improve the method.
betterNextQuestion.plannedEvidence: End with a request for one confusing step and one improvement.

explanationArc.sharedStartingPoint: A reader has found a useful AI practice and colleagues now want the answer.
explanationArc.curiosityGap: What must she share so another woman can adapt it rather than rely on her?
mechanismSequence: A final answer belongs to one situation.
A reusable method exposes the task, inputs, request, check and judgment.
A colleague adapts those elements to her own situation.
Her feedback makes the shared method better.
explanationArc.earnedClick: The valuable thing to pass along is not a clever answer; it is the visible decision process that lets someone else make a sound answer.
explanationArc.smallLanding: Send one low-stakes method note and invite one useful correction.
explanationArc.safetyBoundary: No claim that a community/chat destination exists, no sensitive work details, no film quotation or lyric, and no current product capability claim.

representativeProofPlan.highestRisk: The Saint frame becomes decorative or the action remains generic.
representativeProofPlan.plannedProof: Read the complete candidate aloud against the exact profile/feature direction; verify the article has one causal mechanism, a concrete colleague case, a distinct transfer, a bounded action, the existing card route and the exact track ID.
representativeProofPlan.acceptanceOutcome: A reader can state why a final answer is insufficient and write a four-part method note another woman can test and improve.
